question: What elements must be uttered to form the specified mantra sequence?
premises: The word addressed to Kālikā is uttered
An additional element is placed at its end
That final element is the fire-beautiful-one
inference: One utters the word to Kālikā and places the fire-beautiful-one at its end.
uncertainties: vahnisundarī may denote a specific bīja syllable
